title: Backup
exportDescription: Save all your data into one file you can share or keep somewhere safe.
importDescription: Choose a previously saved backup file to restore your data.
importConfirmMessage: This will overwrite your current data with the contents of the backup file. This action cannot be undone.
importErrorInvalidFormat: This file doesn't look like a valid LifeSort backup.
importErrorParseFailed: The file could not be read. Try a different file.
importErrorUnsupportedVersion: This file was made with a newer version of LifeSort. Update the app and try again.
